correctness.rationale: For s≡±2 modulo p the recurrence first gives v_p(U_n(s))=0 for p∤n. The integer composition identity U_mn=U_m U_n(V_m), with V_m≡±2 in these disks, then raises the valuation by exactly one for each multiplication of the index by p: U_p(w)≡p modulo p² on either disk by Taylor expansion and p≥5. This gives rank p^k on exactly 2p^(k−1) parameters. For unit discriminant the denominator in the root formula is a unit, so the rank is ord(α²) in the appropriate split unit or nonsplit norm-one group. Its cyclic square image has size A_±p^(k−1); in the nonsplit group the principal norm-one generator (1+pη)/(1−pη) has valuation-one displacement and order p^(k−1) by the binomial lift, and the tame group lifts by Hensel. The tame order must exceed one. Each square has two lifts and the resulting trace fibers are inversion pairs of size two, giving φ(r) trace parameters at each admissible rank. The two nontrivial tame divisor lists are disjoint, and all nonramified ranks are strictly below p^k.
